method.projection: Spherical local azimuthal equidistant on each source body; actual PDS radius, Earth6371000m.
method.resampling: GDAL area-weighted average into a local working lattice, then coverage-weighted square box means. Oversampled planetary working cells introduce no new observations. This approximates common aggregation support; native instrument response is still unequal.

limitations: Experimental two-site pilot, not a revised discovery ranking. Original SRTM F/U/C/P remain unchanged.
Source change and smoothing effects are distinct: compare the Copernicus point baseline to its filtered results, not only to SRTM.
Common box support does not calibrate native point-spread functions, measurement errors or mission-safety thresholds.
DSM represents vegetation/buildings and edited water surfaces. Lake Salda water pixels are not bathymetry.
Native MOLA/LOLA products include source-team interpolation; mask coverage is raster availability, not independent instrument coverage.
Offsets, filter sizes and numerical lattice checks describe sensitivity to processing choices, not statistical confidence.
Different vertical reference surfaces: absolute elevations never enter fidelity. No geology or rover-scale hazard claim follows.

source_manifest.hosting_provider: Sinergise / AWS Registry of Open Data
source_manifest.source_kind_note: Dense Copernicus partner DSM data; not NASA SRTM and not visualization-only AWS Terrarium. Existing cached NASA SRTM analysis stays independent.

coordinate_reference.raster_type: RasterPixelIsPoint; use actual GDAL transform including half-pixel offset.

source_manifest.processing_note: AWS COG conversion removes shared south/east edge rows/columns from original1201x1201 grids. Actual COGs are1200x1200 Float32 at3arcsec. No derived terrain/scoring arrays are in this acquisition manifest.

quality_rules.invalid: Exclude nonfinite elevations and pixels whose EDM==0 or FLM==0. Honor actual raster mask/nodata. These GLO90 DEM files declare no scalar nodata; do not invent a zero-elevation or -32767 fill convention.
quality_rules.interpretation: Water codes identify edited/flattened water-surface elevations, not lake-floor bathymetry. DSM includes vegetation/buildings; report filled/edited/water fractions. Masks do not establish mineralogy.

source_manifest.attribution_note: Preserve EULA and its adapted-product attribution; official collection page supplies current required credit notices.
limitations: DSM, not a bare-earth field survey.
Common aggregation area does not remove sensor,epoch,infill,vertical-error or native-response differences.
No rover-hazard certification or field validation.
